title: Wonderful private day trip from Seville to Tangier
text: We had a wonderful private day trip from Seville to Tangler. Everything was well organized, and we really enjoyed discovering Morocco. Our guide was friendly, professional and knowledgeable. We explored the beautiful Medina, visited the Kasbah and enjoyed shopping in the traditional markets. It was a lovely opportunity to experience Moroccan culture in one day
author: 851marint
